title: Gambling, betting and lotteries (online and offline)
summary: Most of the Muslim-majority world, mainland China, North Korea and Kosovo ban gambling outright; most other listed countries allow it only with a local licence or state monopoly. Many Western markets are licence-only for online gambling. US states (e.g. Utah and Hawaii ban all gambling; online casino legal only in a handful of states such as NJ, PA, MI, WV, CT) and Indian states (casinos only in Goa, Sikkim, Daman; many states ban lotteries/betting; several ban even offline games of skill) are not listed as countries. Only ~14 entries cite a read-through source and none is a primary law text; entries marked low are from general knowledge and must be verified. Albania and Kosovo changed recently: verify.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.note: All gambling forbidden under Sharia-based law; from general knowledge, unverified (Wikipedia page used only as pointer).

countries.name: Kuwait
countries.note: Gambling banned; online betting sites reported blocked (secondary overview).

countries.name: Qatar
countries.note: Penal Code criminalises gambling participation and organisation (secondary overview).

countries.name: Bahrain
countries.note: Gambling banned; law reportedly does not mention online betting explicitly but regulators block gambling sites.

countries.name: Oman
countries.note: Gambling forbidden; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.note: Historically prohibited; federal GCGRA now licenses commercial gaming (Wynn Al Marjan, Ras Al Khaimah, opening ~2027) and reportedly some online/sports licences. No general lawful route for an unlicensed app; online scope unclear, check GCGRA register.

countries.name: Iran
countries.note: Gambling prohibited, severe penalties; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Iraq
countries.note: Gambling banned in practice (Sharia-influenced law; some casinos closed); from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Yemen
countries.note: Gambling prohibited; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Afghanistan
countries.note: Gambling prohibited under Taliban rule; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Pakistan
countries.note: Gambling banned (Prevention of Gambling Act 1977, Sharia); from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Brunei
countries.note: Gambling prohibited, Sharia Penal Code; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.note: All gambling criminal (Criminal Code; ITE Law bans online gambling content); from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.note: Muslims banned from gambling; non-Muslims limited to licensed operators (Genting casino, 4D lotteries, racing). Online gambling unlicensed is illegal (Common Gaming Houses Act 1953); from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Bangladesh
countries.note: Gambling prohibited (Public Gambling Act 1867); online sites blocked; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Maldives
countries.note: Gambling prohibited; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Sudan
countries.note: Gambling prohibited under Sharia-based law; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Libya
countries.note: Gambling prohibited; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Algeria
countries.note: Gambling largely prohibited (state lottery/betting exceptions); from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Somalia
countries.note: Gambling prohibited; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Mauritania
countries.note: Gambling prohibited; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Turkey
countries.note: Only state-run Spor Toto/Iddaa and Milli Piyango lotteries lawful; casinos and offshore online gambling illegal and blocked; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Syria
countries.note: Gambling banned; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Jordan
countries.note: Gambling banned (Penal Code), limited state exceptions; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Lebanon
countries.note: Casino du Liban is the only licensed casino; other gambling illegal; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Egypt
countries.note: Strict prohibitions with punitive enforcement (secondary overview); some tourist-hotel casinos for foreigners reported.

countries.name: Morocco
countries.note: Lottery/sport betting state monopoly (La Marocaine des Jeux, SRBE); casinos tolerated for non-Muslims; no route to license private online betting (secondary overview).

countries.name: Tunisia
countries.note: State lottery/betting monopoly; casinos limited to foreigners; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: China (mainland)
countries.note: All gambling banned except state welfare/sports lotteries; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: North Korea
countries.note: Gambling prohibited; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Singapore
countries.note: Gambling Control Act and Remote Gambling Act: only licensed casinos and Singapore Pools/Turf Club; remote gambling prohibited; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Hong Kong
countries.note: Only Hong Kong Jockey Club (racing, football, Mark Six) lawful; all other gambling including online illegal; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Macau
countries.note: Casino concession regime; online casino gaming not licensed; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Vietnam
countries.note: Gambling largely banned; casinos only for foreigners (and limited pilot for locals); online gambling illegal; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Thailand
countries.note: Gambling Act 1935 prohibits gambling except state lottery and horse racing; casino/online reform bills pending, not enacted as of sources read.

countries.name: Myanmar
countries.note: Gambling Law 1899 bans gambling; casinos only in border zones for foreigners; online gambling unlawful; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Cambodia
countries.note: Casinos for foreigners only, Cambodians barred; online gambling banned since 2019-2020 (enforcement irregular); from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Laos
countries.note: Casinos only in special economic zones, nationals barred; online unclear; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: India
countries.note: Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act 2025 bans online real-money games (up to 2 years / INR 5m fine reported). Offline gambling is a state matter (Public Gambling Act 1867; only Goa, Sikkim, Daman allow casinos; state lotteries in some states; many states ban).

countries.name: Sri Lanka
countries.note: Casinos licensed under Betting and Gaming Levy Act, locals barred; online gambling not licensed; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Nepal
countries.note: Casinos for foreigners were licensed but government ordered closure; online gambling banned; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Albania
countries.note: Total gambling ban from 2019 was lifted by Law 18/2024 (in force 27 March 2024): sports betting lawful online only, with a licence; up to ~10 operators planned. As of Aug 2026 the licensing competition had not opened and no operator is licensed. Other online gambling (casino, poker) and land-based betting remain prohibited. Verify current state.

countries.name: Kosovo
countries.note: Law on the prohibition of games of chance (2018) bans all gambling for 10 years, the Kosovo lottery being the only exception; no repeal found in 2025-2026 sources, but the 10-year term may lapse ~2028; enforcement of online betting weak.

countries.name: North Macedonia
countries.note: Market opened 2011 but state-controlled (National Video Lottery); licence required; tightening reforms proposed.

countries.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
countries.note: Fragmented by entity: in the Federation land-based licensees may run online games; online gambling prohibited in Brcko district; licence required.

countries.name: Serbia
countries.note: Games of Chance Act: licence from Ministry of Finance, local presence required (older source); unlicensed online blocked. Verify current rules.

countries.name: Montenegro
countries.note: Online gambling needs a licence, available only to holders of a land-based licence; supervised by Games of Chance Administration.

countries.name: Croatia
countries.note: Online operators need Ministry of Finance licence and a land-based casino.

countries.name: Russia
countries.note: Online casinos prohibited; online betting only by few licensed bookmakers; gambling zones only (Federal Law 244-FZ); offshore sites blocked.

countries.name: Belarus
countries.note: Gambling licensed by state (Gambling Business Act); online limited to licensed operators; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Ukraine
countries.note: Law on State Regulation of Gambling 2020: licensed by PlayCity regulator; unlicensed online gambling illegal; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Kazakhstan
countries.note: Online casinos prohibited; licensed sports-betting/totalizator operators may take bets online; casinos only in designated zones.

countries.name: Uzbekistan
countries.note: Ban ended with a licensing framework effective Jan 2025; first online bookmaker/gaming licences reported 31 July 2026 (National Agency of Perspective Projects). Unlicensed operation unlawful.

countries.name: Azerbaijan
countries.note: Casinos banned 1998; only state lotteries and limited betting; online unlicensed illegal; from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Armenia
countries.note: Gambling law amendments created a regulator and an offshore online licence regime (5% of GGR, reported, status not verified); from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Georgia
countries.note: Licensed by Revenue Service; a licence category for foreign-only online operators reported as planned (June 2026), not confirmed in force.

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.note: Online gambling lawful only with a national licence (or state monopoly); unlicensed offering unlawful. from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Germany
countries.note: Online gambling lawful only with a national licence (or state monopoly); unlicensed offering unlawful. from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: France
countries.note: ANJ licence; online casino games not permitted (only betting, poker, horse racing); FDJ monopoly lotteries. from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Spain
countries.note: Online gambling lawful only with a national licence (or state monopoly); unlicensed offering unlawful. from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Italy
countries.note: Online gambling lawful only with a national licence (or state monopoly); unlicensed offering unlawful. from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Netherlands
countries.note: Online gambling lawful only with a national licence (or state monopoly); unlicensed offering unlawful. from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Poland
countries.note: State monopoly on casino/online casino (Totalizator Sportowy); licensed bookmakers only for betting. from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Sweden
countries.note: Online gambling lawful only with a national licence (or state monopoly); unlicensed offering unlawful. from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Denmark
countries.note: Online gambling lawful only with a national licence (or state monopoly); unlicensed offering unlawful. from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Norway
countries.note: State monopoly (Norsk Tipping, Norsk Rikstoto); foreign operators unlicensed. from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Portugal
countries.note: Online gambling lawful only with a national licence (or state monopoly); unlicensed offering unlawful. from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Australia
countries.note: Interactive Gambling Act bans online casino; online sports betting only with state/territory licence. from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: Canada
countries.note: Provincial licensing/monopolies; Ontario open market (iGaming Ontario); rest provincial sites. from general knowledge, unverified

countries.name: United States
countries.note: Federal law plus state licensing: online casino/sports betting lawful only in licensing states; many states prohibit. Sub-national, see summary. from general knowledge, unverified
